items.exampleEn: Her angry reply was quite uncharacteristic.
items.exampleZh: 她生氣的回應很不像她平常的樣子。

items.exampleEn: Press the peach gently to check its firmness.
items.exampleZh: 輕輕按一下桃子，看看它的硬度。

items.exampleEn: Builders tested the solidity of the new wall.
items.exampleZh: 工人測試了新牆的堅固程度。

items.exampleEn: Our team was unbeatable for three seasons.
items.exampleZh: 我們隊連續三季無人能敵。

items.exampleEn: She felt an indescribable joy when she held the puppy.
items.exampleZh: 她抱著小狗時，感到一種難以形容的喜悅。

items.exampleEn: The long court case was ruinous for the small company.
items.exampleZh: 冗長的官司對那家小公司造成毀滅性的打擊。

items.exampleEn: He looked shaken when he heard the news about his old school.
items.exampleZh: 他聽到母校的消息時，看起來很震驚。

items.exampleEn: The meeting was disorganized, and nobody knew who should speak first.
items.exampleZh: 那場會議毫無章法，沒有人知道該誰先發言。
items.glossZh: 雜亂無章的；沒有條理的

items.sentenceEn: It was uncharacteristic of him to leave without saying anything.
items.sentenceZh: 他一句話也沒說就走了，這很不像他。

items.audioEn: The old bridge has great solidity; it has stood through many strong storms.
items.audioZh: 那座老橋非常堅固，經歷過許多強烈的暴風雨。

items.sentenceEn: Too much sun can be ruinous for old paintings.
items.sentenceZh: 太多陽光可能會毀了老畫作。

items.sentenceEn: I like the solidity of this heavy wooden table.
items.sentenceZh: 我喜歡這張厚重木桌的結實感。

items.stemEn: The view from the mountaintop was so beautiful that it was ____.
items.stemZh: 山頂的景色美得難以形容。

items.stemEn: She spoke with kindness but also with ____, so the students knew she was serious.
items.stemZh: 她說話親切卻也堅定，所以學生知道她是認真的。

items.passageEn: Last year, Mr. Lin opened a small bakery on our street. At first, the shop was disorganized: the bread was never ready on time, and his patrons waited in long lines. But Mr. Lin learned quickly. Now his bread is crisp outside and soft inside, and his prices are unbeatable. The smell in the morning is indescribable. When he won a city baking prize, he could hardly believe it at first, and then he laughed and gave everyone free cake.
items.passageZh: 去年，林先生在我們這條街開了一家小麵包店。一開始店裡亂七八糟：麵包從來沒有準時出爐，客人們都要排很久的隊。不過林先生學得很快。現在他的麵包外酥內軟，價格也無人能比。早上的香味難以形容。他贏得全市烘焙獎時，起初幾乎不敢相信，接著就笑了，還請大家吃免費的蛋糕。

questions.questionZh: 麵包店剛開幕時有什麼問題？
林先生得獎後做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 那輛車差點撞到她之後，她嚇得心神不寧。
referenceEn: She was shaken after the car almost hit her.
After the car nearly hit her, she felt very shaken.
rubricZh: 要用 shaken（例如 was shaken、felt shaken）
「差點撞到」可寫，例如 almost hit、nearly hit 等
時態合理即可（例如 was、felt、is 等）

items.promptZh: 我覺得奶奶煮的雞湯好喝到沒有人比得上。
referenceEn: I think my grandmother's chicken soup is unbeatable.
In my opinion, my grandma's chicken soup is simply unbeatable.
rubricZh: unbeatable 當形容詞（例如 is unbeatable、is simply unbeatable 等）
「我覺得」可寫，例如 I think、in my opinion 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："去年，林先生在我們這條街開了一家小麵包店。一開始店裡亂七八糟：麵包從來沒有準時出爐，常客們都要排很久的隊。不過林先生學得很快。現在他的麵包外酥內軟，價格也無人能比。早上的香味難以形容。他贏得全市烘焙獎時，起初看起來很震驚，接著就笑了，還請大家吃免費的蛋糕。"；改後："去年，林先生在我們這條街開了一家小麵包店。一開始店裡亂七八糟：麵包從來沒有準時出爐，常客們都要排很久的隊。不過林先生學得很快。現在他的麵包外酥內軟，價格也無人能比。早上的香味難以形容。他贏得全市烘焙獎時，起初幾乎不敢相信，接著就笑了，還請大家吃免費的蛋糕。"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：疑似用法不符：shaken 指受到驚嚇／打擊而心神不寧（單字卡釋義也是「震驚的；心神不寧的」），用在「得獎時 looked shaken」語意偏負面、不自然；得獎的驚訝宜用 stunned／amazed，或改成負面情境再用 shaken。
